## Summary

- **`studio/src/utils.js`** — Added `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` export: strips existing `-N` suffix, increments counter until a non-colliding title is found.
- **`studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`** — Imported `generateUniqueTitle`; updated `showClone()` to pre-compute `this.titleClone` from store fragments; updated `cancelClone()` to reset `this.titleClone = ''`; changed `cloneConfirmationDialog` `sp-textfield` value binding from `this.fragment.title` → `this.titleClone`.
- **`studio/src/editor-panel.js`** — Same three changes applied identically.
- **`studio/test/utils.test.js`** — Added 5 unit tests covering: no collision, no-suffix collision, suffix-strip + increment, multi-clone increment, empty array.

```
4 files changed, 49 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)
```
